meta.project: Bilingual, Ontology-Aware, and Explainable ESG Intelligence System
meta.description: Comprehensive reference mapping of the 5-layer integrated research plan to the curated literature corpus, establishing causal traceability from contributions to research questions and empirical evidence.

research_questions: RQ1.1: How can Transformer-based architectures be optimized for bilingual ESG ABSA?
RQ1.3: How can regional calibration and ESG lexicons mitigate bias?

literature_references.title: NusaAksara: A Multimodal and Multilingual Benchmark for Preserving Indonesian Indigenous Scripts
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C1 and RQ1.1 by providing a benchmark for Indonesian low-resource language processing and establishing that existing models struggle with local script nuances.

literature_references.title: From Neurons to Semantics: Evaluating Cross-Linguistic Alignment Capabilities of Large Language Models via Neurons Alignment
literature_references.relevance: Provides the semantic infrastructure (NeuronXA) required for C3 and RQ1.1 to assess cross-lingual alignment efficiency with minimal parallel data.

literature_references.title: Code-Switching Red-Teaming: LLM Evaluation for Safety and Multilingual Understanding
literature_references.relevance: Validates the necessity of bilingual optimization (RQ1.1) by showing that code-switching identifies safety and understanding gaps in multilingual LLMs.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ2.1: How well do 30+ LLMs perform on ESG ABSA tasks?
RQ2.4: How can multi-LLM fusion reduce hallucination?
RQ2.2: How can long-context mechanisms enhance scalability?

literature_references.title: Dynamic and Generalizable Process Reward Modeling
literature_references.relevance: Supports C8 and RQ2.1 by introducing DG-PRM to provide generalized reward signals for benchmarking LLMs as judges in complex process supervision.

literature_references.title: DS2-ABSA: Dual-Stream Data Synthesis with Label Refinement for Few-Shot Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
literature_references.relevance: Justifies C16 and RQ2.1 by demonstrating how dual-stream synthesis overcomes data scarcity in few-shot ABSA scenarios.

literature_references.title: Beyond Output Matching: Bidirectional Alignment for Enhanced In-Context Learning
literature_references.relevance: Establishes the causal link for C10 and RQ2.4 by showing that aligning input preferences reduces computational demands and improves student model robustness.

research_questions: RQ3.1: How can symbolic reasoning be integrated using ESG ontologies?
RQ3.2: How can transparent outputs be ensured via reasoning graphs?
RQ3.3: How can implicit ESG claims be identified?

literature_references.title: GraphCheck: Breaking Long-Term Text Barriers with Extracted Knowledge Graph-Powered Fact-Checking
literature_references.relevance: Direct evidence for C7 and RQ3.2, showing that KG-powered fact-checking captures multihop reasoning chains missed by standard models.

literature_references.title: GraphNarrator: Generating Textual Explanations for Graph Neural Networks
literature_references.relevance: Supports C15 and RQ3.2 by providing a framework for mapping GNN decision processes to natural language explanations.

literature_references.title: iQUEST: An Iterative Question-Guided Framework for Knowledge Base Question Answering
literature_references.relevance: Operationalizes RQ3.1 by using iterative decomposition to maintain coherent reasoning paths in multi-hop KBQA.

research_questions: RQ4.5: Can tone–outcome mismatch reliably indicate greenwashing?
RQ4.1: How can XAI improve stakeholder trust in ESG outputs?

literature_references.title: Real-time Factuality Assessment from Adversarial Feedback
literature_references.relevance: Provides a methodology for C11 and RQ4.5 by using RAG feedback to iteratively modify news into deceptive variants for factuality assessment.

literature_references.title: Hallucination Detox: Sensitivity Dropout (SenD) for Large Language Model Training
literature_references.relevance: Addresses trust risks (RQ4.1) by reducing hallucination variance in training, enhancing model reliability in specialized domains like legal and medical.

literature_references.title: My Words Imply Your Opinion: Reader Agent-Based Propagation Enhancement for Personalized Implicit Emotion Analysis
literature_references.relevance: Supports the implicit analysis goal of C11 and RQ4.5 by simulating reader feedback to resolve subjective variability in emotional narratives.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ5.1: How can transparent and auditable outputs be ensured?
RQ5.2: How can reasoning quality and consistency be operationalized at scale?

literature_references.title: Pre3: Enabling Deterministic Pushdown Automata for Faster Structured LLM Generation
literature_references.relevance: Directly enables the scalability goals of C12 and O5 by optimizing constrained decoding efficiency for structured formats like JSON.

literature_references.title: IAM: Efficient Inference through Attention Mapping between Different-scale LLMs
literature_references.relevance: Supports RQ5.2 by reducing resource consumption (KV cache) during long-context inference, critical for real-world deployment.

literature_references.title: AbGen: Evaluating Large Language Models in Ablation Study Design and Evaluation for Scientific Research
literature_references.relevance: Provides a framework for auditable benchmarking (RQ5.1) by evaluating the faithfulness and soundness of complex study designs generated by LLMs.
